ordered_diagnoses: Metastatic endometrioid endometrial carcinoma to the kidney

facts.raw_span: A 66-year-old woman
a history of endometrioid endometrial carcinoma
abdominal and pelvic pain
Physical examination was unremarkable
a creatinine level of 0.81 mg dl–1
laboratory studies, including a creatinine level, were within normal limits
a right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation located in the upper pole
creating a defect in the renal parenchyma
visible vessels extending into the renal cortex, a finding known as a “renal parenchymal vascular pedicle”
a fatty tumor thrombus within the right renal vein extending to its confluence with the inferior vena cava
No other masses or enlarged lymph nodes were identified

concepts.why: The presence of a right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation, visible vessels extending into the renal cortex, and a fatty tumor thrombus within the right renal vein are characteristic findings of renal cell carcinoma.

The presence of a right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation and visible vessels extending into the renal cortex, along with a fatty tumor thrombus, are highly suggestive of clear cell renal cell carcinoma, a subtype of renal cell carcinoma.
The presence of a right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation is also consistent with angiomyolipoma, a benign renal tumor.
